ROOT_CAUSE: The `_coord_matrix` function incorrectly initializes the matrix for non-separable models with all zeros instead of ones when `pos='right'`, causing nested compound models to lose separability information.
OLD: ```python
    if not model.separable:
        # this does not work for more than 2 coordinates
        mat = np.zeros((noutp, model.n_inputs))
```
NEW: ```python
    if not model.separable:
        # this does not work for more than 2 coordinates
        mat = np.ones((noutp, model.n_inputs), dtype=bool)
```
